title: CE31302: Environmental Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Man, environment and ecosystems. Their inter relationships. Types of
environmental pollutants, their sources and effects. Indoor pollution, Air
pollution, sources, quantities, effects and controls technologies. Noise
pollution. Industrial wastes, and their treatment. Solid wastes, generation,
collection, processing and disposal.Environmental impact assessment and
auditing. Introduction to Environmental laws and policies. Global issues on
environment.
